optimizationExperiments.title: Precomputed FFT-512 Twiddle/Bit-Reversal Tables & Compact Sparse Mel Filterbank Bounds
optimizationExperiments.hypothesis: Eliminating per-frame Math.cos/Math.sin calls and dense 80x256 zero-weight Mel scans speeds up Kaldi FBANK extraction while preserving numerical equivalence (<1e-4) and exact Persian output.

optimizationExperiments.title: Per-Frame Joiner Context Deduplication & O(K) Insertion Top-K in Modified Beam Search
optimizationExperiments.hypothesis: Deduplicating identical (c0, c1) Joiner evaluations across concurrent beams on frame t and removing inner Array.sort() reduces decoder/joiner invocations and wall time with 100% exact Persian transcript parity.

optimizationExperiments.hypothesis: Testing whether dropping the 0.6s zero tail padding speeds up encoder execution without truncating final Persian tokens.
